Top-down concept for a tactical game (Starsector mod: Marines against an engineered biological weapon, the Rav Bloom). ONE creature, the BRUTE: the swarm's slow, heavily armoured ram that smashes through doors, windows and light walls. Reference image 2 is the Runner, the same organism at a young stage: palette family only. Beast first, chitin as armour over muscle. Strict overhead orthographic view, camera looking straight down at its back, facing UP (head toward the top), centred, filling about two thirds of the frame, light from the upper left. Plain flat light grey background (#b4b4b4), no shadow, no ground, no text, no border.

This concept: Bull-leaning, mid age (dusky plum plates with lilac edges): a huge humped shoulder and neck mass much wider than the hips, the horn rising from the hump, legs long and straight under the body.
